source:
flowchart LR
  Client[Web client] --> CDN[CDN]
  CDN --> API[Dashboard API]
  API --> DB[(Postgres)]

flowchart TD
  Page[Browser page] --> SDK[Tracker SDK]
  SDK --> Edge[Edge worker]
  Edge --> Queue[(Event queue)]
  Queue --> Warehouse[(ClickHouse)]

flowchart LR
  User[User] --> Login[Login]
  Login --> Valid{Credentials valid?}
  Valid -- Yes --> Token[Issue token]
  Valid -- No --> Error[Show error]

flowchart TD
  Provider[Payment provider] --> Verify{Signature valid?}
  Verify -- yes --> Save[(Orders)]
  Verify -- no --> Reject[Return 401]

flowchart LR
  Event[Purchase event] --> Analytics[Analytics]
  Event --> Billing[Billing]
  Event --> Email[Email worker]
  Event --> CRM[CRM sync]

flowchart TD
  Ads[Ad spend] --> Report[Daily report]
  Orders[Orders] --> Report
  Sessions[Sessions] --> Report
  Report --> Mail[Send report]

flowchart LR
  Job[Sync job] --> Call[Call partner API]
  Call --> Ok{Succeeded?}
  Ok -- yes --> Done[Mark done]
  Ok -- no --> Retry[Backoff retry]
  Retry --> Call

flowchart TD
  Upload[CSV upload] --> Parse[Parse rows]
  Parse --> Check{Schema valid?}
  Check -- yes --> Import[(Import table)]
  Check -- no --> Download[Download errors]

flowchart LR
  Client --> Gateway
  subgraph API[API service]
    Gateway --> Auth
    Auth --> Handler
  end
  Handler --> Store[(Tenant DB)]

flowchart TD
  subgraph Browser
    Page --> SDK
    SDK --> Buffer
  end
  subgraph Edge
    Worker --> Validate
    Validate --> Publish
  end
  Buffer --> Worker
  Publish --> Stream[(Event stream)]

flowchart LR
  Raw[(Raw events)] --> Normalize[Normalize]
  Normalize --> Enrich[Enrich campaign]
  Enrich --> Facts[(Analytics view)]
  Raw --> Archive[(Archive)]

flowchart TD
  Visit[Visit page] --> Consent{Consent granted?}
  Consent -- yes --> Track[Send event]
  Consent -- no --> Anonymous[Keep anonymous]
  Anonymous --> Metrics[(Aggregate metrics)]

flowchart LR
  사용자[사용자] --> 대시보드[대시보드]
  대시보드 --> 조회[전환 데이터 조회]
  조회 --> 저장소[(분석 저장소)]

flowchart TD
  Request --> Flag{Feature enabled?}
  Flag -- on --> New[New experience]
  Flag -- off --> Old[Existing experience]
  New --> Metrics[(Exposure metrics)]

flowchart LR
  Request --> Cache{Cache hit?}
  Cache -- yes --> Response[Return response]
  Cache -- no --> API[Read API]
  API --> DB[(Postgres)]
  API --> Put[Fill cache]
  Put --> Response

flowchart TD
  Queue[(Queue)] --> Worker[Process worker]
  Worker --> Result{Processed?}
  Result -- yes --> Sink[(Warehouse)]
  Result -- no --> DLQ[(Dead letter queue)]
  DLQ --> Replay[Replay worker]
  Replay --> Queue

flowchart LR
  Cart[Cart] --> Price[Calculate price]
  Price --> Payment[Authorize payment]
  Payment --> Approved{Approved?}
  Approved -- yes --> Order[(Create order)]
  Approved -- no --> Declined[Show decline]

flowchart TD
  Alert[Alert trigger] --> Rules[Evaluate rules]
  Rules --> Email[Email]
  Rules --> Slack[Slack]
  Rules --> Pager[Pager]

flowchart LR
  App[Dashboard] --> Redirect[Redirect to identity provider]
  Redirect --> Callback[OAuth callback]
  Callback --> Exchange[Exchange code]
  Exchange --> Session[(Session store)]

flowchart TD
  Scheduler[Hourly scheduler] --> Extract[Extract partner data]
  Extract --> Transform[Transform rows]
  Transform --> Load[(Daily facts)]
  Load --> Refresh[Refresh dashboard]

flowchart LR
  User --> Web
  subgraph Platform
    subgraph Services
      Web --> API
      API --> Policy
    end
    Policy --> Audit[(Audit log)]
  end
  Audit --> Export[Compliance export]

flowchart TD
  subgraph Ingest
    Receive --> Validate
  end
  subgraph Process
    Normalize --> Persist
  end
  Validate --> Normalize
  Persist --> Events[(Event facts)]

flowchart LR
  A1[Source A] --> B1[Processor 1]
  A1 --> B2[Processor 2]
  A2[Source B] --> B1
  A2 --> B2
  B1 --> Sink[(Sink)]
  B2 --> Sink

flowchart TD
  A[Input A] --> X[Rule X]
  A --> Y[Rule Y]
  A --> Z[Rule Z]
  B[Input B] --> X
  B --> Y
  B --> Z
  C[Input C] --> X
  C --> Y
  C --> Z
  X --> Out[Output]
  Y --> Out
  Z --> Out

flowchart LR
  Client --> API --> DB[(Primary DB)]
  Cron[Cleanup cron] --> Archive[(Archive store)]

flowchart TD
  Start[Receive a tenant-scoped conversion event with campaign attribution metadata] --> Validate[Validate schema and deduplicate by stable event identifier]
  Validate --> Store[(Write normalized immutable event record)]

flowchart LR
  Request --> Limit{Within tenant rate limit?}
  Limit -- yes --> Execute[Execute query]
  Limit -- no --> Wait[Return retry-after]
  Execute --> Result[Return result]

flowchart TD
  Request[Deletion request] --> Identify[Identify tenant data]
  Identify --> Delete[(Delete records)]
  Delete --> Verify{Deletion verified?}
  Verify -- yes --> Confirm[Send confirmation]
  Verify -- no --> Escalate[Open incident]

flowchart LR
  Deploy[Deploy release] --> Migrate[Run migration]
  Migrate --> Healthy{Health check?}
  Healthy -- yes --> Serve[Serve traffic]
  Healthy -- no --> Rollback[Rollback release]
  Rollback --> Deploy

flowchart TD
  Stream[(Ad events)] --> Partition[Partition by tenant]
  Partition --> W1[Worker shard 1]
  Partition --> W2[Worker shard 2]
  Partition --> W3[Worker shard 3]
  W1 --> View[(Canonical view)]
  W2 --> View
  W3 --> View

flowchart LR
  Payment --> Score[Risk score]
  Score --> Review{Manual review needed?}
  Review -- yes --> Analyst[Analyst queue]
  Review -- no --> Capture[Capture payment]
  Analyst --> Capture

flowchart TD
  Config[(Tenant config)] --> Sync[Sync scheduler]
  Sync --> Partner[Partner API]
  Partner --> Diff[Compute diff]
  Diff --> Apply[(Apply changes)]
  Apply --> Config

flowchart LR
  Query[Search query] --> Parse[Parse filters]
  Parse --> Auth[Authorize tenant]
  Auth --> Search[(Search index)]
  Search --> Rank[Rank results]
  Rank --> UI[Render table]

flowchart TD
  Export[Export request] --> Scope[Resolve tenant scope]
  Scope --> Build[Build CSV]
  Build --> Object[(Object storage)]
  Object --> Link[Email signed link]

flowchart LR
  Monitor[Monitor] --> Detect{SLO breached?}
  Detect -- yes --> Incident[Create incident]
  Incident --> Mitigate[Mitigate]
  Mitigate --> Review[Post-incident review]
  Detect -- no --> Continue[Continue monitoring]

flowchart TD
  Event --> Version{Supported schema?}
  Version -- yes --> Decode[Decode payload]
  Version -- no --> Quarantine[(Quarantine)]
  Decode --> Canonical[(Canonical events)]

flowchart LR
  Signup --> Tenant[Create tenant]
  Tenant --> Invite[Invite members]
  Invite --> Install[Install SDK]
  Install --> First[First event]
  First --> Active[Mark active]

flowchart TD
  Usage[(Usage events)] --> Aggregate[Aggregate monthly usage]
  Aggregate --> Invoice[Create invoice]
  Invoice --> Charge[Charge card]
  Charge --> Paid{Paid?}
  Paid -- yes --> Receipt[Send receipt]
  Paid -- no --> Dunning[Retry collection]

flowchart LR
  Request[Backfill request] --> Range[Split date range]
  Range --> Job1[Job one]
  Range --> Job2[Job two]
  Range --> Job3[Job three]
  Job1 --> Merge[(Merge facts)]
  Job2 --> Merge
  Job3 --> Merge

flowchart TD
  Action[Privileged action] --> Allow{Policy allows?}
  Allow -- yes --> Execute[Execute action]
  Allow -- no --> Deny[Reject action]
  Execute --> Audit[(Audit record)]
  Deny --> Audit

flowchart LR
  Visitor --> Assign{Experiment bucket}
  Assign -- control --> Control[Control experience]
  Assign -- treatment --> Treatment[Treatment experience]
  Control --> Measure[(Exposure event)]
  Treatment --> Measure

flowchart TD
  Request --> Token{Token expired?}
  Token -- no --> API[Call API]
  Token -- yes --> Refresh[Refresh token]
  Refresh --> Token
  API --> Response[Return response]

flowchart LR
  Request --> Resolve[Resolve tenant]
  Resolve --> Policy[Load tenant policy]
  Policy --> Route{Region}
  Route -- Korea --> KR[(Korea warehouse)]
  Route -- Global --> Global[(Global warehouse)]

flowchart TD
  subgraph Client
    Browser --> Collector
  end
  subgraph Cloud
    subgraph DataPlane
      Collector --> Ingest
      Ingest --> Stream
    end
    Stream --> Facts
  end
  Facts[(Event facts)] --> Dashboard

flowchart LR
  BranchA[Feature branch] --> CI[CI checks]
  BranchB[Dependency update] --> CI
  CI --> Gate{All required checks pass?}
  Gate -- yes --> Main[Merge main]
  Gate -- no --> Fix[Fix failures]

flowchart TD
  Facts[(Daily facts)] --> Nulls[Check null rate]
  Facts --> Volume[Check volume]
  Facts --> Freshness[Check freshness]
  Nulls --> Gate{All checks pass?}
  Volume --> Gate
  Freshness --> Gate
  Gate -- yes --> Publish[Publish dashboard]
  Gate -- no --> Alert[Alert owner]

flowchart LR
  Producer --> Topic[(Topic)]
  Topic --> ConsumerA[Consumer A]
  Topic --> ConsumerB[Consumer B]
  ConsumerA --> StoreA[(Facts)]
  ConsumerB --> StoreB[(Audit)]

flowchart TD
  Render[Render diagram] --> Primary{Primary renderer works?}
  Primary -- yes --> SVG[Return SVG]
  Primary -- no --> PNG[Return PNG]
  PNG --> Terminal[Terminal fallback]

flowchart LR
  요청[내보내기 요청] --> 권한{권한 확인 완료?}
  권한 -- 예 --> 생성[보고서 생성]
  권한 -- 아니오 --> 거부[요청 거부]
  생성 --> 파일[(객체 저장소)]

flowchart TD
  Browser --> Socket[Open websocket]
  Socket --> Auth{Authenticated?}
  Auth -- yes --> Subscribe[Subscribe channel]
  Auth -- no --> Close[Close connection]
  Subscribe --> Updates[Stream updates]

flowchart LR
  Raw[(Raw events)] --> Age{Older than retention?}
  Age -- yes --> Compact[Compact partitions]
  Age -- no --> Keep[Keep hot]
  Compact --> Cold[(Cold storage)]

flowchart TD
  Change[Production change] --> Review[Code review]
  Review --> Approved{Approved?}
  Approved -- yes --> Deploy[Deploy]
  Approved -- no --> Revise[Revise change]
  Revise --> Review

flowchart LR
  Email[Email address] --> Lookup[Lookup identity]
  Cookie[Browser cookie] --> Lookup
  Device[Device identifier] --> Lookup
  Lookup --> Profile[(Unified profile)]

flowchart LR
  subgraph ControlPlane
    Config[(Config)] --> Publisher
  end
  subgraph DataPlane
    Consumer --> Apply
    Apply --> Runtime[(Runtime state)]
  end
  Publisher --> Consumer

flowchart TD
  Dashboard --> API --> Facts[(Facts)]
  Backup[Weekly backup] --> Snapshot[(Snapshot)]
  Docs[Documentation build] --> Site[Docs site]

flowchart LR
  Event --> Key[Compute idempotency key]
  Key --> Seen{Already processed?}
  Seen -- yes --> Ignore[Ignore duplicate]
  Seen -- no --> Write[(Write event)]

flowchart TD
  Event --> Kind{Event type}
  Kind -- pageview --> Page[Pageview processor]
  Kind -- purchase --> Purchase[Purchase processor]
  Kind -- identify --> Identity[Identity processor]
  Page --> Facts[(Facts)]
  Purchase --> Facts
  Identity --> Facts

flowchart LR
  Client --> Gateway[API gateway]
  Gateway --> Auth[Authorization]
  Auth --> Config[Config service]
  Auth --> Reports[Reports service]
  Auth --> Admin[Admin service]

flowchart LR
  Update[(Config update)] --> Commit[Commit transaction]
  Commit --> Invalidate[Invalidate cache]
  Invalidate --> Notify[Notify subscribers]
  Commit --> Audit[(Audit log)]

flowchart TD
  Internal[(Internal orders)] --> Compare[Compare totals]
  Partner[(Partner settlements)] --> Compare
  Compare --> Match{Totals match?}
  Match -- yes --> Close[Close period]
  Match -- no --> Investigate[Investigate variance]

flowchart LR
  Collect[Collect] --> Validate
  Validate --> Enrich
  Enrich --> Attribute
  Attribute --> Aggregate
  Aggregate --> Serve[Serve metrics]
  Validate --> Reject[(Rejected events)]

flowchart TD
  subgraph Inbound
    Webhook --> Verify
    SDK --> Verify
  end
  subgraph Core
    Verify --> Normalize
    Normalize --> Persist
  end
  Persist[(Event store)] --> Consumer

flowchart LR
  Scheduler --> Snapshot[Create snapshot]
  Snapshot --> Encrypt[Encrypt snapshot]
  Encrypt --> Vault[(Backup vault)]
  Vault --> Test[Restore test]

flowchart TD
  Request --> Tenant[Resolve tenant]
  Tenant --> Plan{Plan tier}
  Plan -- free --> Free[Free limits]
  Plan -- pro --> Pro[Pro limits]
  Plan -- enterprise --> Enterprise[Enterprise limits]
  Free --> Execute
  Pro --> Execute
  Enterprise --> Execute

flowchart LR
  In1 --> P1
  In1 --> P2
  In1 --> P3
  In2 --> P1
  In2 --> P2
  In2 --> P3
  In3 --> P1
  In3 --> P2
  In3 --> P3
  P1 --> Out
  P2 --> Out
  P3 --> Out

flowchart TD
  Submission --> Score[Score submission]
  Score --> Threshold{Above threshold?}
  Threshold -- yes --> Auto[Auto approve]
  Threshold -- no --> Human[Human review]
  Human --> Decision{Approved?}
  Decision -- yes --> Auto
  Decision -- no --> Reject[Reject]

flowchart LR
  Request --> Verify[Verify tenant claim]
  Verify --> Scope[Apply row scope]
  Scope --> Query[(Tenant-scoped data)]
  Query --> Response

flowchart TD
  Prompt[Diagram source] --> Revision[Increment revision]
  Revision --> Render[Render SVG]
  Render --> Fresh{Latest revision?}
  Fresh -- yes --> Display[Display result]
  Fresh -- no --> Drop[Drop stale result]

flowchart LR
  Source[Mermaid source] --> Policy[Source policy]
  Policy --> Safe{Safe?}
  Safe -- yes --> Iframe[Sandbox iframe]
  Iframe --> SVG[Semantic SVG]
  Safe -- no --> Error[Show validation error]

flowchart TD
  Request --> Locale{Locale}
  Locale -- ko-KR --> Korean[한국어 보고서]
  Locale -- en-US --> English[English report]
  Korean --> Export[(Export file)]
  English --> Export

flowchart LR
  User --> View[Open interactive viewer]
  View --> Fit[Fit diagram]
  Fit --> Zoom[Zoom and pan]
  Zoom --> Source[Toggle source]
  Source --> View

flowchart TD
  Release --> Build[Build artifact]
  Build --> Staging[Deploy staging]
  Build --> Preview[Deploy preview]
  Staging --> Verify[Verify release]
  Preview --> Verify
  Verify --> Production[Deploy production]

flowchart LR
  Local[(Local config)] --> Diff[Compute diff]
  Remote[(Remote config)] --> Diff
  Diff --> Conflict{Conflict?}
  Conflict -- no --> Apply[Apply update]
  Conflict -- yes --> Resolve[Manual resolution]
  Resolve --> Apply

flowchart TD
  subgraph Client
    App[Dashboard app] --> SDK[Visualization request]
  end
  subgraph RenderService
    SDK --> Validate[Validate Mermaid]
    Validate --> Render[Render SVG]
    Render --> Cache[(Artifact cache)]
  end
  subgraph Delivery
    Cache --> Viewer[Interactive HTML viewer]
    Cache --> Image[PNG fallback]
    Cache --> Text[Terminal fallback]
  end

flowchart TD
  subgraph intake[1. Plan and intake]
    PLAN[Work request] --> INTAKE{Issue lint passed?}
    INTAKE -.->|revise| PLAN
    INTAKE -->|yes| LINEAR[Backlog to In Progress]
  end
  subgraph build[2. Isolated TDD]
    LINEAR --> WORKTREE[Feature worktree]
    WORKTREE --> TDD[Red to Green to Refactor]
    TDD --> LOCAL{Local checks pass?}
    LOCAL -.->|no| TDD
    LOCAL -->|yes| DRAFT[Draft PR]
  end
  subgraph gate[3. Review gate]
    DRAFT --> REVIEW[CI and review]
    REVIEW -.->|finding| WORKTREE
    REVIEW -->|clean| STABLE{Stable snapshot?}
    STABLE -.->|no| WORKTREE
    STABLE -->|yes| MERGE[Merge ready]
  end
  subgraph release[4. Release loop]
    MERGE --> DEPLOY[Staging and E2E]
    DEPLOY -.->|red| WORKTREE
    DEPLOY -->|green| PROD[Production evidence]
    PROD -.->|failure| WORKTREE
  end
intent: 실사용 SDLC의 cross-subgraph feedback과 표준 edge label
